g.title: AiLearningArchitecture
g.text: AI Learning — Edge Activation, Gated Application & On-Site Club Architecture (Accepted v1.3)

g.title: cluster_edge
g.text: Part 1: Edge, Activation & Auth Gate (GCP LB Frontend mTLS + Cloud Armor + IAP + GCIP)

g.title: cluster_app
g.text: Part 2: Single Source of Truth — Cloud Run Application & Domain Layer (TypeScript + Node)

g.title: cluster_club
g.text: Part 3: Physical Club & Disconnected Support (On-Site i7 / 128 GB Server, No Moodle/Authentik)

g.title: lb_armor
g.text: HTTPS Load Balancer (Frontend mTLS allow-missing) + Cloud Armor
Injects LB-overwritten X-Client-Cert-* headers | WAF + per-IP throttling

g.title: approved_adult
g.text: Google SSO Only in IAP Prod (Multi-Role)

g.title: club_runtimes
g.text: • 12 Laptops + 15 Tablets (2 Rooms, device client certs, ephemeral profiles)

g.title: sync_mtls
g.text: Frontend mTLS X-Client-Cert-* (No browser IAP, no Origin CSRF)

g.title: gcip
g.text: Identity Platform (GCIP, Email Enumeration Protection ON)
• students (single global tenant; ACTIVE only; Argon2 batchCreate/updateUser)

g.title: onboarding_api
g.text: Tenant=applicants only | Rate-limited per Google sub

g.title: fastify_api
g.text: Fastify + Mercurius GraphQL (Cloud Run, Single Source of Truth)
• Fail-closed SYSTEM ContentScopeCheck | Isolated Cloud Run pyret-npm worker
• Kid LLM access BLOCKED (coding-agent & TOS rule)

g.title: postgres
g.text: • Users (roles[], PHC passwordHash, birthYear, GDPR <16 consent, ErasureTombstone)
• Locations, Rooms, ClubDevices (cert SHA256), TeacherClearances, Courses, LiveClassSessions, Attendance
• KnowledgeNode (lang tag) + KnowledgeDependency DAG + Mastery + PyretWorkspaceState

g.title: fastify_api->gcip
g.text: supervisors pre-create, ACTIVE kid batchCreate/update, suspensions/erasures

g.title: club_cache
g.text: • Delegated Location Ed25519 signing keypair (public key in cloud JWKS)
• Cleared kid + teacher offline PHC hashes (24-72h TTL) + ErasureTombstones

g.title: fastify_api->club_cache
g.text: Sync pull: roster, PHC hashes (24-72h TTL),

g.title: llm_adapter
g.text: • Adult-only Cloud APIs (Gemini/Vertex prohibited by policy for <18 / student work)
• Phase-2+ security-gated student tutor/proof-eval ONLY via self-hosted vLLM or Anthropic minors path
• Local teacher-laptop CLI via on-site club server / adult bridge (never inbound cloud->laptop TCP)
Zero kid PII | Metered per Subscription | Runtime SSRF guards | Adult Review & Fail-Closed SYSTEM Scope Gate

g.title: club_cache->fastify_api
g.text: attempts, attendance, LiveClass, conflict-safe Pyret, offline LLM usage

g.title: club_cache->club_runtimes
g.text: Mint local Ed25519 JWTs / offline auth
